items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I know him, yes, I met him.

ctx.x: I've got some good trombone players over there. We're on Rheel 2 now, huh, Saladier. Now, you got this picture made at the Italian Hall? Yes, there, on Barrow Street.
And whose band is it? You know Joe Maxey? I know him, yes, I met him. Trombone, I know him. Well, this is the original WPA band, in fact it was the EO Ray band before the WPA.
I play with Tom too, Tom Brown.
